title: POV: your baby's meeting could have been an email
hook: POV: your baby's meeting could have been an email.

scenes.caption: 9 a.m. Mandatory meeting. His idea.
scenes.image_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: standing on a chair at the head of a colorful boardroom table, tapping a tiny watch, adult cartoon coworkers yawning, bright office
scenes.motion_prompt: the baby taps his watch impatiently and points at the empty chairs, coworkers shuffle in yawning, gentle camera push in

scenes.caption: Slide one of forty.
scenes.image_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: pointing a laser pointer at a huge projector screen showing a pie chart made of cookies, coworkers staring blankly
scenes.motion_prompt: the baby waves the laser pointer wildly across the screen, one coworker slowly leans back and closes his eyes

scenes.caption: Any questions? No. Good.
scenes.image_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: arms crossed, chin up, at the head of the table, coworkers frozen with hands half raised, bright office
scenes.motion_prompt: the baby crosses his arms and nods proudly, a coworker slowly lowers his hand, subtle zoom

scenes.caption: The dog was not invited. He came anyway.
scenes.image_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: a big golden retriever wearing a tie sits at the table next to the baby, the baby glares at him, coworkers giggling
scenes.motion_prompt: the dog wags his tail and knocks a coffee cup over, the baby turns his head slowly and glares, coworkers giggle

scenes.caption: Meeting adjourned. Nap time.
scenes.image_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: asleep on the boardroom table with his head on a stack of papers, tiny blanket, coworkers tiptoeing out, warm light
scenes.motion_prompt: the baby breathes softly in his sleep, coworkers tiptoe out of frame one by one, the lights dim slightly

description: Bo, the Baby of Wall Street, hosts a mandatory 9 a.m. meeting. Nobody survives slide one.
visual_prompt: 3D Pixar-style cartoon: walking into a bright colorful office lobby with a tiny briefcase and a big grin, coworkers in the background
hook_motion: the baby struts into the lobby swinging his briefcase, coworkers turn their heads, playful camera follow
